ticker_news.title: Mophie Expands Its Qi2 Lineup with Four New Wireless Charging Stands
ticker_news.description: Mophie launched four new Qi2 wireless charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods, offering fast charging up to 15W with magnetic alignment and space-saving designs, ranging from $44.95 to $99.95.
ticker_news.author: Ekshita Kumar

ticker_news.title: Think It's Too Late to Buy MP Materials? Here's 1 Reason Why There's Still Time.
ticker_news.description: MP Materials, a rare-earth metals mining company, has seen significant stock growth in 2025 due to strategic partnerships with the Department of Defense and Apple. Despite a 27% pullback, the stock remains attractive due to its potential in domestic rare-earth metal supply and national security importance.
ticker_news.author: Steven Porrello
